1.6.1: Migration completed to Newb_Bridge and minor fixes/qol fixes.
1.7.2: Each carrier now keeps its own condition, tier and serial number. Five carrier tiers are available.
A plate HUD in the bottom right shows the worn carrier and its plates. Players can toggle it, and it hides when the pause menu opens.
Players can manage worn and stored carriers from one menu. The menu explains why a carrier cannot be repaired.
Using a repair plate while wearing a carrier repairs it in place.
Police can check the serial numbers of carriers in a bag or worn by the nearest person.
A carrier worn when a player leaves is restored when they log back in.
Heavier carriers slow players slightly. You can turn this off.
The config has moved to resource/open/shared/config.lua.
1.7.3: The code is reorganised into modules, and the open settings file moved to resource/open/shared/config.lua. Move any edits you made in the old configs/config.lua across.
The README now covers the five carrier tiers, the plate HUD, the management menu and the police serial check, with the keys for each. Text is translated into 29 languages.

1.0.0: Initial release. Digital Pets is a handheld virtual pet toy: hatch an egg, care for the pet, level it up and play with it on the toy's tiny screen.

31 pixel pets and 10 mini-games (Cooking, Slingshot, Joyride, De-Escrow, Taco Pinball, Takosu Fight, Bee Care, Serpent, Block Stacker, Cheesy Go-Kart), plus a toy shop with passive bonuses, hats, shell skins, room scenes, fortune cookies, trophies and daily streaks.
Outings to Los Santos landmarks with a map marker and the toy prop to find, a pedometer that boosts walks, and favourite spots that make pets happy.
The pet lives in the inventory item, so trading or stashing the item moves the pet with it. Uses Newb_Bridge (QBCore, Qbox and ESX). Everything is set up in game with /setupdigitalpets.
1.0.2: Pets can get sick. Four medicines are new: syrup and antibiotic cure a sick pet, vitamin and tonic are safe on a healthy one.
Digital Pets settings now live in the database and load to players when they spawn, so they can be changed in game with the setup panel and no resource restart.
The code is reorganised into modules. The setup panel and the toy screens are rebuilt, and Kora Framework is supported through Newb_Bridge.
Scrap recyclers: players load items, run the machine and collect materials. Uses Newb_Bridge (QBCore, Qbox and ESX).
Staff place and configure recyclers in game with /setuprecycling: stations as a prop, ped or box zone, recycler types that set efficiency, recipes and colour, and a library of recycler models.
Default recipes use stock items (phone, radio and lockpick into plastic, metalscrap and copper). An optional murder mode, off by default, adds six body-part items.
1.0.4: Murder mode has new settings in the setup panel: a chance for the victim to break free, a chance that dispatch is alerted, and an insert cooldown.
The setup command is /setuprecycling. Percent settings use sliders in the panel.
Debug logging prints plain one-line messages and can be switched on and off live from the setup panel. The recycler server code was rewritten and the rotor script was removed.
Kora Framework is supported through Newb_Bridge, with a Kora item list for the optional murder mode loot.

1.0.0: In-game garage creator with personal storage, private, job and gang fleets, keyholders, transfers and impound for QBCore, Qbox and ESX through Newb_Bridge.

Everything is set up in game with /setupgarage: a guided setup wizard plus a Manage tab to build, edit and delete garages, import and export garage packs, and look up or move owned vehicles. /privategarage gives private-garage creators their own cut-down panel.

Impound with reasons, holds, self-retrieve and a police release board, store repair fees, slot limits and prices, an early release surcharge, society fund payouts, a Discord event log, saved vehicle dents and vehicle pictures.
Spawns are validated by the server with duplicate-spawn protection, and impound claims, slot changes and ownership changes use conditional or transactional database writes.

1.1.2: RadioIntrusion now uses Newb_Bridge for its framework, inventory and dispatch support.
Players need a radio in their inventory to use the device.
A failed crack sends a dispatch alert to the jobs you set.
Radio channel joins are logged through ox_lib.
The config has moved to resource/open/shared/config.lua.

0.0.4: Players can now do yoga on mats. Completing the poses restores health and reduces stress by a random amount.
Use mats placed around the map, or mat items players put down themselves (up to three each). An optional ped sells the mats.
Sessions are checked on the server: players must be near an unused mat, and a cooldown limits repeat sessions.
Yoga now uses Newb_Bridge for framework and inventory support.
